subject: Run spike S-4: AMC webhook end-to-end smoke harness
description:
Validate HMAC verification, dedupe behavior under retry, mark_read idempotency, and error-code surfacing against a real AMC instance. Produces the smoke-test harness reusable across phases.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Build a smoke-test harness that posts signed webhooks to a local Capo stand-in and verifies the listener path end-to-end.
- [ ] Confirm AMC's `X-AMC-Delivery-Id` retry behavior (signed retries arriving within the documented window must be deduped).
- [ ] Verify `mark_read` returns success on idempotent re-marking of the same `message_id`.
- [ ] Capture the exact AMC error-code surface (`RATE_LIMITED`, `PLATFORM_AUTH`, `CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND`, `ATTACHMENT_TOO_LARGE`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`) against the real instance.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Document AMC behavior on signature mismatch and on missing `X-AMC-Delivery-Id`.
- [ ] Document AMC's retry window length and dead-letter timing.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Smoke: real AMC instance webhook + REST round-trip
• Output: `internal/specs/spikes/S-4-amc-webhook-e2e.md` findings doc

**Output**: Findings document at `internal/specs/spikes/S-4-amc-webhook-e2e.md` plus the reusable smoke-test harness.

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Section 9.0 (Spike S-4)
